audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 4 and 6 of the level chart disagreed with the packet, and rows 0 and 4 also contradicted the page's own prose in both layers.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Skill at 53.03% over 347 games. whys[0] already says 'neither owns it yet' while the row said Irelia; whys[4] and phases[4].why are both written as Irelia's kill window while the row said Skill. The sejuani-side mirror already moved the two-item row to Skill.
audit.corrected: Skill / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Irelia / Skill, proposed as matched full+content pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two-item stage was written as Irelia's despite the page's own late-game text saying Sejuani comes back online on tank items.
audit.why: Sejuani scales on resists plus Glacial Prison (120/105/90s, 1300 range, stuns the first champion hit). Irelia's spike is level 3 to first item. Level 6 is Irelia's: Vanguard's Edge creates terrain that cuts the exit of a champion whose only escape is Arctic Assault on an 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Irelia, two-item stage to Skill, matching the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two mechanical errors. (a) Irelia's passive is credited with 'on-hit armor shred' in five places — it grants stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage at max stacks, and shreds nothing. (b) The whole page tells the player to engage 'on Permafrost's cooldown'; Permafrost is a 1.5s ability that can only be cast on a target already at maximum Frost stacks, so there is no cooldown window to wait out.
audit.why: Riot's text for Irelia's passive: stacking bonus Attack Speed, bonus damage on hit at max stacks. Riot's text for Permafrost: 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', cd 1.5, cost 20. The real gate is Frost application from Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s) and autos, so the trade window is before she stacks you, not after she casts.
audit.corrected: Passive restated as attack speed plus on-hit damage; the tracked resource changed from 'her cooldown' to 'your Frost stacks'. Also noted Frost Armor is an out-of-combat buff that lapses shortly after she takes damage, so its resists do not survive an extended trade.

audit.whatIsWrong: The punishable cooldown was named as Permafrost, which is 1.5s.
audit.why: Her genuinely punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault — 18s at rank 1, 16.5s at rank 2 — her only disengage and her only gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Arctic Assault's real numbers written into whys[3] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani is referred to as 'his'/'him' in several full-layer fields.
audit.why: Sejuani is female; the mirror audit flagged the same pronoun problem and could not complete the pass.
audit.corrected: Fixed in the fields edited here; the rest are listed in notes.

notes: Biggest correction: the entire page was built around 'engage on Permafrost's cooldown'. Permafrost has a 1.5s cooldown and can only be cast on a target already at maximum Frost stacks, so the real window is before Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s) and her autos stack you — the advice as written told the player to wait for a gap that never appears. Second: Irelia's passive was credited with on-hit armor shred in five places; Riot's text gives stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage only. Frost Armor is an out-of-combat buff that persists only briefly after she takes damage, so its resists do not survive an extended trade — that is why the long fight favours you, not any shred. Chart flipped in matched pairs on rows 0, 4 and 6. Pronoun pass incomplete and inherited from the previous run: winCon, enemyWin, tldr, ahead, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[0], report[1], report[11] and report[12] still call Sejuani 'his'/'him' — several of those are also built on the false Permafrost-cooldown framing and want a rewrite in a later pass. Not verified and therefore left alone: whether Frost Armor's slow immunity blocks the Vanguard's Edge wall slow, and whether Flawless Duet's stun is applied before Sejuani's passive shatter can be triggered by her allies.
